tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Explicit cycles generating homology of spheres and disks] ↗ cor:homology-spheres 1. ch2:2.23\group Singular Homology

For the two-simplex model of $S^n=D^n/\partial D^n$, the signed difference of the two top simplices represents the generator of $\widetilde H_n(S^n)$; the corresponding relative top cell represents the generator of $H_n(D^n,\partial D^n)$. \end{example}
